answer: A concrete Sybil defence is stake-weighted verifier assignment with slashing. Each agent identity must post a bond before it grades, and the scheduler fills quorums from a per-epoch weighted pool, so one operator grinding thousands of cheap keys barely moves its odds of seizing a quorum. When a falcon correlation pass flags a cluster voting as one bloc, the bond is forfeited rather than the reward. Each extra fake identity becomes a paid liability: the attacker pays the full bond per account before buying a whisper of influence, while quorum power rises sublinearly. hollow keys are a net loss
